# anthropic_memories (Data Source)

Lists the memories in a Managed Agents memory store, without their content. Compare `content_sha256` against a local hash to find changed memories, and read one with the `anthropic_memory` resource or the API.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_memories" "style" {
  memory_store_id = anthropic_memory_store.conventions.id
  path_prefix     = "/style/"
}

output "style_paths" {
  value = [for m in data.anthropic_memories.style.memories : m.path]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `memory_store_id` (String) Memory store to list (`memstore_...`).

### Optional

- `path_prefix` (String) Only list memories under this prefix, which must end with `/`, for example `/conventions/`. The prefix is sent in the request URL, so keep secrets and personal data out of it.

### Read-Only

- `memories` (Attributes List) Memories, in the API's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--memories))

<a id="nestedatt--memories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `memories`

Read-Only:

- `content_sha256` (String) Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the content.
- `content_size_bytes` (Number) Content size in bytes.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Memory id (`mem_...`).
- `memory_version_id` (String) Current version (`memver_...`).
- `path` (String) Path within the store.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
